sentences.ar: وفهمت شو قال لي الفيل، بلا كلام.
sentences.en: And I understood what the elephant had told me, without words.
It said: you want ivory?
Here is ivory.
Take it, and let us live.
And I sat on the hill, and wept.
I went back to my master on foot, two days.
And when he saw me, he said: I thought you dead!
The elephants pulled up the tree!
